title: Activate and refine provisional rubrics with bounded class-aware evaluation
description: Fix cold-start empty rubric and undersized evaluation gates. Initialize nonempty working rubric, refine provisionally, invalidate stale head and refit separately. Persist truthful activation status and full exchanges. Cap each candidate development evaluation at 200 samples with recent stratified selection; expose configurable decaying recency Brier allowance based on scarce-class coverage. Retain unaccepted hypotheses for later evaluation. Verify with offline specs and bounded operational replay; do not claim majority accuracy establishes alignment.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented nonempty provisional initialization and refinement, durable status, stale-head invalidation, separate refitting, and pending-proposal reuse. Bounded replay completed 87 cycles, 320 decision requests and 4 optimizer calls: rubric initialized cycle 20 and refined cycle 80; all 7 later decisions used the refined rubric, with no blank rubric after initialization. Added EvaluationPolicy: 200 samples per candidate comparison, recent stratified selection and configurable linearly decaying recency allowance based on scarce-class development counts. Replay preceded the latest configurable allowance addition; that addition is covered by offline specs. Evaluation remains provisional, not a demonstrated high-recall classifier.
